STASJONSGATA 10-12 EIENDOM AS is a private limited company (AS), founded on 2010-12-05, registered in Øvre Eiker.
It reported revenue of NOK 1.15M for 2025 and an operating result of NOK 173,422 (2025).
Its 2025 accounts show an operating margin of 15.1% and a thin equity ratio of 1% of total assets.

Revenue rose 2.2% from 2024 to 2025 (NOK 1.12M to NOK 1.15M); it was NOK 1.09M in 2023. The annual result went from a profit in 2024 to a loss in 2025 (2023: NOK 179,373, 2024: NOK 29,964, 2025: -NOK 303,560).
STASJONSGATA 10-12 EIENDOM AS is led by CEO Morten Brørby and board chair Åse Hardang.
It has a board of 4. The register last recorded a change to its roles on 2025-11-04 (within the past year).
